dealSummary: Polymarket is in talks to raise more than $1 billion in a new funding round at a $20 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported.
Happyrobot, a startup developing AI agents for mission-critical enterprises, raised a $150 million Series C led by Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Convex, which builds backend infrastructure for AI-written software, raised a $57 million Series B led by Insight Partners.
Tel Aviv-based QuantHealth, which uses AI to simulate clinical trials, secured a $45 million Series B led by Qumra Capital.
Amsterdam-based battery startup Ore Energy raised a $43 million Series A led by Plural and HV.
Yellow Card, a stablecoin payments infrastructure provider, raised $40 million from investors including SC Ventures, Sony Innovation Fund and Polychain Capital.
leadInvestors: SC Ventures, Sony Innovation Fund, Polychain Capital

dealSummary: Singapore-based Multiplier, which acquires professional-services firms and builds AI tools around their operations, raised a $35 million Series B led by The General Partnership.
Maximum, which builds an AI operating system for banks, raised a $30 million seed round led by CRV.

Advanced Electric Machines, a UK-based maker of rare-earth and magnet-free electric motors, received £16 million in a round led by investors including Barclays Climate Ventures, PXN Ventures and Northstar Ventures, Tech.eu reported.
leadInvestors: Barclays Climate Ventures, PXN Ventures, Northstar Ventures, Tech

dealSummary: Delightree, the developer of an AI operating system for franchise brands, raised $25 million from investors including Innovius, Accel and Timber Grove Ventures.
